title: Visual Reference Manifest
description: Structural validation for a visual reference manifest. Passing this schema is only the first validation stage.
$comment: validateVisualReferences is mandatory after JSON Schema validation. It enforces semantic invariants that JSON Schema does not claim to enforce here: unique reference IDs, unique binding.property values regardless of fidelity, bound/excluded conflicts, context ownership, and overlapping exact scopes.

scope.description: Structural scope coordinates. Page/region ownership and exact-scope overlap are enforced by the runtime validator.

bindings.description: Structural binding list. uniqueItems rejects identical objects; binding.property uniqueness across different fidelity values is enforced by the runtime validator.

exclude.description: Structurally unique exclusions. Conflicts between exclusions and bindings are enforced by the runtime validator.
